description: 20-item eval set referenced in the PRD (section 5: Success Measurement & Evals). Each input is a real editorial-style Arabic topic; `expected` encodes the same structural rules the server enforces in postProcessor.js and evaluator.js, so pass/fail can be checked by anyone without an editor in the loop.
